camel_example: aliyun oos SearchInventory --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken gAAAAABfTgv5ewUWmNdJ3g7JVLvX70sPH90GZOVGC --Filter.1.Value.1 'i-bp1cpoxxxxxxxxxxxxxx' --Aggregator.1 'ACS:Application.Name' --MaxResults 50 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Filter.1.Operator Equal --Filter.1.Name 'ACS:InstanceInformation.InstanceId'
description_en: Queries the details or aggregate information of a configuration checklist
description_zh: 查询配置清单的详细信息或聚合信息
kebab_example: aliyun oos search-inventory --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --next-token gAAAAABfTgv5ewUWmNdJ3g7JVLvX70sPH90GZOVGC --max-results 50 --filter '[{"Operator":"Equal","Value":["i-bp1cpoxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"],"Name":"ACS:InstanceInformation.InstanceId"}]' --aggregator ACS:Application.Name --region cn-hangzhou

parameters.help_en: The page size. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小。取值范围：1-100。默认为50
parameters.name: max_results

fields.help_en: The property name of the component (N ranges from 1 to 5). Different components have different internal property names. Use GetInventorySchema (https://api.aliyun.com/#/?product=oos&version=2019-06-01&api=GetInventorySchema) to query the property names of different components. For example, the ACS:InstanceInformation component has a property named InstanceId, so you set this parameter to ACS:InstanceInformation.InstanceId
fields.help_zh: 组件的属性名称(N取值范围1-5)。不同的组件内部属性的名称不同。使用GetInventorySchema (https://api.aliyun.com/#/?product=oos&version=2019-06-01&api=GetInventorySchema)查询不同组件的属性名称。例如：组件ACS:InstanceInformation下有InstanceId这个属性，所以本参数则取值为ACS:InstanceInformation.InstanceId
fields.name: name

fields.help_en:
The comparison operator for the component property query value (N ranges from 1 to 5).

Valid values:
Equal
NotEqual
BeginWith
LessThan
GreaterThan
fields.help_zh:
组件属性查询值比较符(N取值范围1-5)。
取值范围：
Equal
NotEqual
BeginWith
LessThan
GreaterThan
fields.name: operator

fields.help_en: The list of component property query values
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The aggregators. You can use one or more aggregators to query instance aggregate information.

ACS:Application.Name
ACS:Application.Version
parameters.help_zh:
聚合器。可以使用一个或多个聚合器查询实例聚合信息。
取值范围：
ACS:Application.Name
ACS:Application.Version
parameters.name: aggregator

items.description_en: The detailed configuration checklist or aggregate information returned by the component query
items.description_zh: 组件查询的详细配置清单，或聚合信息
